Check same-origin route readiness only after install execution reaches a terminal state.

recovery: Retry only through the FastAPI-owned app action after the backend reports it safe; do not run install commands from the UI.

checks: GET /api/lite/recovery/summary
items.name: Backup failure

checks: Check the Caddy process state through the approved service status path.
Validate the tracked Caddy configuration before any restart.
items.name: Caddy unavailable
recovery: Use the existing Caddy restart helper only after configuration validation; keep same-origin routing intact.

checks: Check invite lifecycle, last heartbeat, command progress, and supervisor status.
Distinguish joining/waiting from an enrolled offline device.
items.name: Device joining, waiting, or repairing
recovery: Allow guarded enrollment/recovery to converge; use explicit repair/rejoin only for verified identity or enrollment failure.

checks: GET /api/lite/fleet
Check Tailnet and NATS reachability through documented diagnostics
items.name: Device offline or reconnecting
recovery: Distinguish disconnected from stopped before restarting anything

checks: Run the deterministic documentation check tasks
Run strict MkDocs build
items.name: Documentation drift
recovery: Regenerate from canonical sources; do not hand-edit generated truth

checks: Compare the promoted release binding with local Git tag availability.
Confirm the tag exists in verified remote/session metadata before fetching it.
items.name: Release tag missing locally
recovery: Use the existing promotion preflight safe remediation to fetch only the verified missing tag; do not fabricate a tag.

checks: Inspect NATS readiness through backend diagnostics
Confirm the worker reports messaging connectivity
items.name: NATS or JetStream unavailable
recovery: Restore NATS reachability before retrying backend-owned commands

checks: Run parity evidence checks and inspect the failing evidence lane
items.name: Parity or browser capture failure
recovery: Recapture only the failed bounded lane; do not promote incomplete evidence

checks: GET /api/lite/catalog
Inspect same-origin app route readiness
items.name: PhotoPrism unavailable
recovery: Use backend-owned Check app or Repair actions; do not run app process control in the browser

checks: Check Recovery freshness and the authoritative database recovery projection.
Confirm whether the degradation reason is projection_too_old.
items.name: Recovery projection stale
recovery: Refresh/reconcile through the existing backend projection path; require a fresh restore preview before destructive restore.

checks: GET /api/lite/release
Verify release binding and post-switch health
items.name: Release or rollback issue
recovery: Use the last-known-good rollback path only after release verification fails

checks: GET /api/lite/fleet
Inspect sanitized remote-access readiness
items.name: Remote access not ready
recovery: Restore tailscaled, Tailnet address, and NATS reachability in that order

checks: GET /api/lite/recovery/summary
items.name: Restore blocked or preview stale
recovery: Refresh Recovery state and create a fresh preview before destructive restore

checks: Run lite:evidence:runtime:preflight with the explicit release tag
items.name: Runtime evidence or release binding mismatch
recovery: Resolve the real source/release/evidence mismatch; do not rewrite tags or hide semantic drift

checks: GET /api/lite/security/summary
GET /api/lite/security/progress

recovery: Use the saved backend troubleshooting state and explicit retry after terminal failure

checks: Check promoted evidence timestamp, source commit, and release binding.
Check whether semantic parity and operational health are being reported independently.
items.name: Stale runtime evidence
recovery: Capture a new sanitized runtime projection and explicitly promote it only after validation; never track transient raw capture.

checks: Check supervisor and node-agent PM2 status separately.
Confirm the device is not merely disconnected while the agent process is running.
items.name: Supervisor stopped
recovery: Restore the supervisor through the approved PM2/runtime startup path, then verify a fresh heartbeat.

checks: Check tailscaled status and whether a Tailnet IPv4 is available.
Check NATS reachability over the configured secondary/Tailnet URL.
items.name: Tailscale unavailable
recovery: Start tailscaled only through the existing safe startup helper and re-check remote-access readiness.

checks: GET /api/lite/status through the configured Pocket Lab origin
Inspect Caddy service state through the documented runtime topology
items.name: Pocket Lab UI unavailable
recovery: Restore Caddy/PWA serving before attempting write actions

checks: Check PM2 worker status and sanitized worker/NATS health.
Confirm the durable command consumer is healthy before retrying a write.
items.name: Worker stopped
recovery: Use the existing supervisor/PM2 recovery path; do not queue commands from the browser.
